title: Guardrail map — what to build and where
summary: No attack. Turn everything you broke and fixed into a design checklist: threat → guardrail → where it lives in the lab. This is the interview answer.
takeaway: Secure mode is not a safe LLM. It is policy enforced outside the LLM, on every hop — including data and identity.
design_rule: Draw user → DLP → RAG → planner → identity → executor → tools and put a control on each hop.
